name: Shinshiro (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shinshiro city emblem in green and yellow: a green stylised mountain crossed by a yellow curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Shinshiro, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Shinshiro city emblem — a green stylised mountain crossed by a yellow curved stroke
